rationale: Applies a surgical patch to the current best 9x512 reverse-tail script: final evaluation uses a 0.94 gain on the earlier replayed tail block while the final tail replay remains full strength. This targets the exact int8+zlib path with a compile-stable recurrence-profile change, leaving training, data resolution, quant-aware export, and print formats intact.
title: Soft-Capped Penultimate Tail Eval Gain
